import json, subprocess, sys, random, itertools, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import exact_ref as R, fuzz as F, fuzz2 as F2, fuzz3 as F3

rng = random.Random(1234)
stats = collections.Counter()
bad = 0
for t in range(120):
    doc = F3.make(rng)
    core, scopes, rounds, finals = F2.core_of([(x['path'], x['count']) for x in doc['rib']], doc['ixps'])
    m = len(core)
    if not (2 <= m <= 6): continue
    outs = {}
    for perm in itertools.permutations(range(m)):
        w = R.width_of(list(perm), scopes)
        d = json.loads(json.dumps(doc))
        d['order'] = [[core[i][0], core[i][1]] for i in perm]
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(d).encode(),capture_output=True)
        got = json.loads(p.stdout)
        if w > 4:
            if got != {'error':'invalid'}:
                bad += 1; print('FAIL wide order accepted', t, perm, w, json.dumps(got)[:200])
            stats['wide-rejected'] += 1
        else:
            if 'error' in got:
                bad += 1; print('FAIL narrow order rejected', t, perm, w, json.dumps(got)[:200])
            else:
                key = json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True)
                outs.setdefault(key, []).append(perm)
                stats['narrow-accepted'] += 1
    if len(outs) > 1:
        bad += 1
        print('FAIL order-dependent output', t, [ (len(v),) for v in outs.values()])
        print(json.dumps(doc)[:1500])
print(stats, 'bad', bad)
PYEOF
